overview: On Mars, an extraordinary young adept arrives as rival visions of the Mechanicum’s future threaten to divide the forge world.
synopsis: Dalia Cythera is brought from Terra to Mars, where her unusual gifts attract the attention of the forge mistress Koriel Zeth. Her work on an ambitious device intersects with the politics of a society divided over innovation, belief and the authority of Terra.

Fabricator-General Kelbor-Hal and his allies move toward rebellion, while rival forges and Titan forces choose their positions. The resulting conflict tears through the Mechanicum and leads Dalia toward a secret beneath the surface of Mars.
detailed: Dalia arrives on Mars under the protection of Koriel Zeth. In Zeth’s forge, she joins a group working on the Akashic reader, a machine intended to access knowledge on an unprecedented scale. The project’s ambitions challenge established doctrine as much as they push technical limits.

The political division within the Mechanicum deepens. Kelbor-Hal is drawn toward promises of forbidden knowledge and freedom from the restrictions imposed by Terra. Other forge leaders assess the coming conflict through their own ambitions and loyalties.

The release of destructive scrapcode spreads corruption through Martian systems. Civil war engulfs forge complexes and the Titan Legions. Zeth’s efforts and the stand of loyalist forces cannot preserve the old unity of Mars.

Dalia’s journey takes her beneath the planet, where she encounters the imprisoned Dragon and the responsibility associated with its guardianship. The quest for a machine that can reveal all knowledge gives way to a duty defined by what must remain contained. Mars emerges from the conflict divided and devastated.
